# Governance Templates

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Work Templates](../README.md)**

---

> Templates and checklists for EA governance processes and gates. These support the formal review and approval workflows defined in the [Architecture Governance Framework](../../../governance/processes/architecture-governance.md).
